candidate_c_proposal.name: Disagreement-Gated Residual MLP
candidate_c_proposal.core_idea: Frozen physical anchor plus a small MLP producing a residual magnitude and a sigmoid gate from a shared hidden layer; applied correction is gate * magnitude, letting the network suppress correction when models agree and apply it when they disagree.

anchor.units_for_addition: raw W/m^2, read directly from existing feature column

candidate_c_proposal.first_stage_status: FROZEN - anchor is a fixed input value, not a model parameter; no gradients flow into producing it

parameter_count.verification_method: direct PyTorch instantiation (nn.Linear x3) + sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()), to be confirmed at implementation time; NOT YET RUN

training_configuration.batch_construction: 8 origins per batch (192 rows), rows processed independently, origin-grouped for protocol consistency only

preprocessing.anchor_scaling: kept raw/unstandardized separately for the additive step; standardized copy also included among the 39 network inputs

inner_validation_protocol.leakage_guarantee: internal validation origins are a subset of that fold's training pool; test-fold origins never used for early stopping

candidate_c_proposal.causal_justification: Zero new features or data sources introduced; all 39 inputs, including pred_stage4_fold and disagreement_fold, were already causally verified at t0 in the Candidate A design checkpoint's causality audit.

distinctiveness.vs_stage_5_2: neural (small MLP) not GBDT; explicit multiplicative gate structure not guaranteed to emerge from generic tree splits; purpose-built around the disagreement-direction question
distinctiveness.vs_phase9_candidate2: operationalizes the explicitly-flagged-as-untested directional correction, via a learned gate rather than a raw input feature
distinctiveness.vs_candidate_b: anchor + gated-residual decomposition, row-wise and asymmetric, vs. single-stage symmetric joint regression with no anchor
distinctiveness.vs_candidate_a: no sequence coupling at all; distinguishing structure is the anchor/gate/residual decomposition, not temporal modeling
distinctiveness.worth_testing_despite_a_b: A and B both compete on the same axis (single learned function predicting the absolute target end-to-end). Candidate C never attempts that axis - it tests a structurally different, previously-flagged-but-unbuilt hypothesis, independently informative regardless of A/B outcomes
